reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing shared assertBankAccountNotLinked, linkBankSyncAccount and link.findOrCreateBank, and the balance handling reuses the akahu branch; only the download path does not reuse anything because no shared downloader exists.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near line-for-line copy of downloadAkahuTransactions/downloadPluggyAiTransactions (token check, post, error mapping, response shaping) instead of factoring the common provider download.

placement.why: Each piece lands where its siblings live: handler and link function in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, base URL in server-config.ts, account type in types/models.

scope.why: Only what the Fintegra server-side integration needs.

maintainability.why: Linking is cleanly shared; the copied download function adds one more copy to keep in sync with the other providers.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in accounts/sync.ts is an open copy of downloadAkahuTransactions with names changed, not reshaped.
